en.topic_title: Northern Metropolis: Hong Kong homes flattened for HK$224 billion high-tech hub
en.topic_summary:
Chan Yuk-tong hoped to spend his remaining years in the row of small, blue-brick houses where he was born and raised, but the 71-year-old’s Hong Kong village home will soon be bulldozed to make way for a vast tech hub.



Resident Niki So (L1) and her family stand behind the gate of their village house as Hong Kong government officers carry out a land resumption operation against them in the Kwu Tung area of Hong Kong’s northern New Territories, on June 23, 2026. Photo: Leung Man Hei
